sv.title: Dynavox justerar redovisade nyckeltal
sv.summary: Dynavox, som utvecklar kommunikationshjälpmedel, justerar tidigare redovisade alternativa nyckeltal. Det framgår av ett pressmeddelande.

en.title: Dynavox adjusts reported key figures
en.summary: Dynavox, which develops communication aids, is adjusting previously reported alternative key figures. This is according to a press release.
